partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Disease-cell-localized causal inhibition
results.hypothesis: A causal-gene inhibitor is more credible when the gene is expressed in a cell type in which the disease is located.
results.body: drug decreases bound causal gene; Bgee gene expression and disease location share exact cell
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule localizes a causal target to a disease-associated cell type, but cell expression and location edges are broad.
results.trapi_notes: The target, expression, and disease-cell paths are TRAPI-expressible; shared cell identity, provenance, and ontology filters require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (gene)-[expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->(cell:Cell)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(cell)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN coalesce(expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
